test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 27 Jan 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Identify the spelling error in the given sentences and select the option that rectifies the error.**

It is necessary for candidates to carry their examination addmit cards with them.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Admit**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct spelling of the word is "**admit**".
 
• The word means to allow someone to enter a place or to acknowledge
